legal.draft.note: This page is a template. Have it reviewed before Vedit opens to the public.
legal.contact.label: Takedown and privacy requests
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.use.p: Vedit cuts long videos into short clips. You can use it only for videos you own or have permission to edit and share.
terms.content.p: You keep ownership of everything you upload. You give Vedit permission to store and process your files only to make the clips, captions and exports you ask for.
terms.rules.p: Do not upload content that you do not have the right to use, content that is illegal, or content that harms other people. We may remove such content and close the account that uploaded it.
terms.limits.p: Each account has a monthly amount of analysis time and a storage allowance. Files you do not keep may be deleted after a while.
terms.takedown.p: If you believe a file on Vedit infringes your rights, write to the address below with the link to the file and what you want removed.
terms.warranty.p: Vedit is provided as it is. Clips and captions are made automatically, so check them before you post.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.collect.p: Your account details (name and email, or the Google or Facebook profile you sign in with), the videos and images you upload, and what is made from them.
privacy.use.p: Your files are used only to make your clips, captions and exports, and to show you your own projects. They are not shown to other people and are not used to train models.
privacy.services.p: Files are stored with a cloud storage provider, videos are processed on cloud servers, and sign-in is handled by an account service. Each of them handles your data only to run Vedit.
privacy.delete.p: You can delete a project or an uploaded file at any time. To delete your account and everything in it, write to the address below.
privacy.contact.p: For questions about your data, write to the address below.
